mapper.sql: id, question, answer, keywords, category, priority, hit_count, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE faq_qa SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM faq_qa WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT FROM faq_qa WHERE deleted = 0
AND (question LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND category = #{category}
ORDER BY priority DESC, create_time DESC

SELECT FROM faq_qa WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND ( MATCH(question, keywords) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) OR question LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR answer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN question LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, priority DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE faq_qa SET hit_count = hit_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM faq_qa WHERE deleted = 0 AND category IS NOT NULL AND category != '' ORDER BY category
